visualCharacteristics: Auto-scrolling marquee strip of 10 images. Edge-to-edge horizontal strip of equal-width images (~4 visible on desktop) with mixed 16:9 / 4:3 aspect ratios, bottom-aligned, continuously looping; no text, no controls. Sits in the 'manifesto' section below centred intro text.
contentPattern: Per slide (row): cell 1 image + alt (10 unique images, de-duplicated from the 20 source DOM slides); cell 2 optional caption richtext (empty in source). Section metadata style: manifesto.
